headline: Show clients what SEO is worth
body: Free ROI calculator. Traffic, conversion rate, order value in. Projected revenue out.
caption:
Tired of explaining SEO spend with a shrug?

Our new ROI calculator turns traffic, conversion rate, and order value into a projected revenue number you can put in front of a client. Free, no signup.

Try it free at upgrowth.io/tools/seo-roi
alt_text: Announcement card reading Show clients what SEO is worth, with the Upgrowth logo and a Try it free button.
notes: Context mentions 40 agency owners requested this. Left out of the graphic to keep it clean, but usable in a follow-up post.
